meta.name: hybrid-cloud-networking
meta.description: Configure secure, high-performance connectivity between on-premises infrastructure and cloud platforms using VPN and dedicated connections. Use when building hybrid cloud architectures, connecting data centers to cloud, or implementing secure cross-premises networking.

copy.tagline: 构建本地与云端的安全连接通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在本地数据中心与云平台间建立安全连接
copy.tagline_en: Connect your on-premises data center to cloud securely
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to establish secure connectivity between on-premises and cloud.

howto.what: 帮你规划并配置本地数据中心与云平台（AWS、Azure、GCP、OCI）之间的连接，选用 VPN 或专线，产出 Terraform 配置、BGP 路由与双隧道高可用方案。
howto.when: 当你需要把本地数据中心连到云、搭建混合云架构，或做跨站点安全组网时触发。

say.text: 配置双 VPN 隧道加 BGP 自动故障切换，做成 active-active
say.note: 会给出主备隧道与 BGP/ECMP 设置

howto.what_en: Helps plan and configure connectivity between on-premises data centers and clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI) via VPN or dedicated links, producing Terraform configs, BGP routing, and dual-tunnel HA designs.
howto.when_en: Use when connecting on-premises data centers to cloud, building hybrid cloud architectures, or implementing secure cross-premises networking.

say_en.text: Set up an AWS Site-to-Site VPN from my data center to a VPC with Terraform
say_en.note: Outputs VPN gateway, customer gateway, and connection HCL

say_en.text: Design a hub-and-spoke hybrid topology with Transit Gateway and VPCs
say_en.note: Returns topology and route propagation config

say_en.text: Configure dual VPN tunnels with BGP failover for active-active
say_en.note: Gives primary/secondary tunnels and BGP settings
